title: Svenska manliga förnamn (Swedish male first names)
description: Swedish male first names (förnamn) registered to at least two people in Sweden as of 31 December 2020, with the number of bearers per name. A förnamn is any given name a person holds, whether or not it is the name they go by. 75584 unique names. Sourced from Statistics Sweden (SCB) name statistics, compiled in the svensktext open Swedish language-resource collection.
